description: Linux kernel intent-style relevance queries. Queries avoid exact function names and regex syntax so the benchmark measures contextual retrieval, ranking, and spam demotion.

queries.query: where does kernel allocate tiny reusable memory objects
queries.intent: Small object allocation should favor core slab/slub allocator implementation over driver object wrappers.

queries.query: where are page faults resolved after missing memory mapping
queries.intent: Page-fault resolution should favor mm fault handling and architecture fault entry points.

queries.query: how does scheduler choose next runnable task
queries.intent: Scheduling decisions should favor core scheduler code, not GPU scheduler wrappers or selftests.

queries.query: where are deferred background work items executed
queries.intent: Deferred work execution should favor workqueue internals, not unrelated filesystem item structs.

queries.query: where are eBPF programs checked before running
queries.intent: BPF safety checks should favor kernel verifier code over selftest programs.

queries.query: where does packet receive processing enter network stack
queries.intent: Packet receive processing should favor net/core ingress paths over security or tracing examples.

queries.query: where are block IO requests queued to hardware
queries.intent: Block request dispatch should favor blk-mq internals and headers.

queries.query: where does filesystem dentry lookup cache names
queries.intent: Dentry cache lookup should favor VFS dcache/namei code over unrelated filesystem caches.

queries.query: how does CPU frequency governor update policy
queries.intent: Frequency policy updates should favor cpufreq core/governor code.

queries.query: where does lock dependency tracking catch deadlocks
queries.intent: Lock dependency and deadlock detection should favor lockdep implementation.

queries.query: how are thermal trip points handled
queries.intent: Thermal trip handling should favor thermal core/trip implementation.

queries.query: where does kernel collect entropy for random bytes
queries.intent: Random-byte entropy should favor random driver implementation and header.

queries.query: how are cgroup memory charges tracked
queries.intent: Memory cgroup charging should favor memcontrol implementation.
